content.text: Shortening the shaft and thickening the head proportions to match the target.

I built the part as a hex-head bolt lying along the X axis, with the head at the +X end, and exported it to `submission.step`. The STEP file reads back as one valid solid that matches the part.

- **Shaft:** Ø10 cylinder, 100 long, from X=0 to X=100.
- **Head:** hexagon 17 across the flats and 7 thick, from X=100 to X=107.
- **Overall size:** 107 × 19.6 × 17.

I got the axis and which end the head is on by working out where +X falls in each of the four target views. All four agree.

The proportions are estimated by eye from the target image. I rendered the four views at 93 long with an 8-thick head, and they looked very close to the target. I then lengthened the shaft and thinned the head slightly to match it better, but I didn't render that final version. I also left out the small chamfer or washer face that seems to be on the head in the target, so the head is a plain hexagonal prism.
